title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 21 July 2012.

It was the final show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

Starr had previously performed at the Greek Theatre on 3 and 4 September 1989, 11 and 12 August 1992, 18 and 19 August 1995, 2 August 2008, and 7 August 2010. He returned there on 19 July 2014, 2 July 2016, 29 September 2018, 1 September 2019, 15 June 2023, 8 September 2024, and 14 June 2026.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums

The band was joined by Joe Walsh for ‘Rocky Mountain Way’.
